results.content: Donald Trump’s problems are having a major, perhaps decisive, impact on the 2026 race for control of the Senate. Driven by high prices and an unfinished war with Iran, his national job approval stands at just 39.6% compared to a disapproval rating of 57.0%—a net negative of 17.4%—and it is even worse in several states that could make the difference between a Republican and Democratic Senate majority after the midterms.
